This maize plot is small but important for our food, so I will give it the care it deserves. I will buy a little DAP and urea from the cooperative, though not the full package — cash is tight — and I will also spread manure from our animals, which I have always done. For maize I will use the improved seed since it gives better yield, but I will not waste money on pesticide, and we have no irrigation here, only the rains. My children and I will do most of the work, but I may pay a neighbor for a couple of days during weeding since I am 60 and my back is not what it was.
